summary: Evergy, Inc., Evergy Kansas Central, Inc. and Evergy Metro, Inc. jointly filed a combined Form 8-K dated November 5, 2026, reporting under Items 2.02 (Results of Operations), 7.01 (Regulation FD), 8.01 (Other Events) and 9.01 (Financial Statements and Exhibits). No transaction, stake, price per share or structural terms are disclosed in the excerpt; the filing concerns quarterly results and related disclosures. No board recommendation, advisor or regulatory clock is stated. Nothing here constitutes a special situation; monitor the attached earnings exhibits for guidance changes, rate-case developments and capital plans.
